title: Community quiz score correction
passage:
Document 1 | Northnook Community Quiz, score desk card
Teams hand in a signed answer sheet for each round. Record any question you want reviewed on a separate review slip. A review can correct an error in how marks were added, but it cannot replace a submitted answer.
The hall board displays preliminary scores. Final certificates use the register, not the board. If a review changes a score after the last round, update the register first. Correct the board if it is still up; do not put it back up just for a late correction.
Document 2 | Message from the score desk after the final round
Team Birch asked us to check questions 8 and 9. Their signed answer to question 8 is “Oak,” and a member asked to change it to “Ash.” They did earn a mark for question 9, but the total did not include it. Their score in the register is 23 and needs one more mark. The hall board came down when the audience left. The certificates have not been printed. We will hold certificates for absent participants at the welcome desk rather than mailing them.

文件一｜Northnook 社區問答賽：計分台須知
每回合各隊都要繳交一張簽名的答題紙。若要複查某題，請另填複查單。複查可更正計分加總錯誤，但不能換掉已繳交的答案。
場內看板公布暫定分數。最終證書採用成績登記簿上的分數，不以看板為準。若最後一回合後複查造成成績變動，請先更新登記簿。看板若還在，就更正看板；不要只為補做遲來的更正而把看板重新架起來。
文件二｜最後一回合後，計分台發出的訊息
Birch 隊請我們複查第 8、9 題。第 8 題在簽名答題紙上的答案是「Oak」，一位隊員要求改成「Ash」。他們第 9 題確實有得分，但沒有算進總分。登記簿目前記有 23 分，應再加 1 分。觀眾離開時已撤下看板。證書尚未印製。缺席者的證書會先留在迎賓服務台，不會郵寄。
